elements.char: A natural cubic spline (also known as restricted cubic
elements.label: text

elements.char: spline) is a set of cubic polynomials with continuity and
elements.label: text

elements.char: slope constraints at each knot, and additional constraint
elements.label: text

elements.char: of linearity at the extremes of the curve, typically before
elements.label: text

elements.char: the first and after the last knot [12, 16, 20, 21]. This extra
elements.label: text

elements.char: linearity constraint makes the trajectory less erratic at the
elements.label: text

elements.char: ends of the age distribution and so more reliable than lin-
elements.label: text

elements.char: ear splines (and unrestricted cubic splines). The inclusion
elements.label: text

elements.char: of cubic terms with continuity constraints means natu-
elements.label: text

elements.char: ral cubic spline models can be more parsimonious for
elements.label: text

elements.char: complex shapes than a linear spline with many knots. An
elements.label: text

elements.char: The flexibility of regression splines is determined by the
elements.label: text

elements.char: number/position of the knot points. For a natural cubic
elements.label: text

elements.char: spline, the number of knots (rather than their position) is
elements.label: text

elements.char: more important [20]. A small number of knots (between
elements.label: text
